header: The fixed selections, one entry each: its words, its example lines, and the way a typed line is made its own. Adding a selection takes one entry here (and its engine call in src/lib/nl2sql/omnibar.ts). I keep only `examples` lines that really work: src/records/records.selftest.ts runs them through the engines that can run offline.

symbols.name: doctorDegreesAsked
doc: A line that asks for the DEGREES or QUALIFICATIONS of DOCTORS ("list the degrees of the doctors"): I answer it from the hospital's list of doctors and their qualifications, not from the table of degrees

doc: The other choice of the second row that is not a record: Admin, the management pages (Employee, PAX directory, Holiday, Circular and Announcement managers, the Contact access log). Nothing here is searched: the button asks the server who is signed in and shows the management page that person may open, or says they are not authorised. The words of each page are checked in src/lib/facility/hub.selftest.tsx.
